The '''Ritual of the Children''' was performed by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], likely a [[Shaman/Legends|Shaman]], before cutting down a tree.

The Ewok [[Grael]] was shocked when he discovered [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] had cleared trees en masse and without performing this ritual.<ref name="escape">{{JournalCite|1|Escape from Balis-Baurgh}}</ref>
